Good to know

Your Pokey
questions, answered.

Does Pokey buy or sell my cards?

The published app description presents Pokey as a card browsing and personal collection tool, not a marketplace.

Are displayed card values guaranteed?

No. Market information changes and may not reflect a particular card’s condition, region, fees or eventual selling price.

How do I get help with Pokey?

Email info@digitalsprout.org with your device, app version and a description of the issue. You can also visit our support page.
